articles.title: Kraken parent Payward says expansion outside crypto trading helps cushion revenue decline
articles.snippet: While earnings and the company’s newly introduced financial performance measure remained below year-earlier levels, there are signs of improvement from the second quarter.

articles.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Huang quits company he co-founded, led for 3 decades. Shares slump
articles.snippet: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, as shares tumble.

articles.title: UK bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand into stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: The Series B funding round, led by Octagon Partners valued the London-based company at more than $100 million.

articles.title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
articles.snippet: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.
